name: Graph-color symbolic matched-budget closeout and HB-2 skeleton
purpose: Extend the matched-budget primary mechanism-isolation result to graph_color for the symbolic-CBJ/oracle-search targeting variant, using selected v16_p04 graph_color instances, n=64, R=16, A_cache vs C_incontext, and the same solve@budget grid/CI logic. Also add the external no-train BudgetRunner protocol/provenance registry for HB-2 without fabricating any external curves. C1-targeting graph_color A/C curves remain pending because the existing C1 implementation has A-cache rows but no C_incontext counterpart yet.

provenance.spec: user CODING SPEC — Next Step, graph_color matched-budget close + external no-train HB-2 (v0)

code_added_used.change: Builds graph_color solve@budget curves, B* selection, Wilson CIs, and A-C gap summaries from A/C graph_color search rows.
Defines BudgetRunner protocol and no-train external baseline provenance/status registry.

commands.purpose: Run graph_color selected-instance symbolic A/C rows.
Build solve@budget curve and CI summaries.
Record BudgetRunner protocol and external baseline provenance/status.

headline.graph_color_symbolic: n=64, v16_p04/R16. B*=22901 with C_midband=0.40625. A solve=1.0, C solve=0.40625, gap=0.59375, conservative gap CI [0.4148,0.7054].
headline.shape: A dominates C over all five graph_color symbolic grid budgets; promotion_points=4/5, high-budget point has small positive gap but CI touches 0 as C nearly catches up.
headline.primary_status: Together with item121 sudoku/futoshiki, symbolic-CBJ mechanism-isolation is positive on 3/3 tasks. Full promotion still waits for graph_color C1-targeting variant and external HB-2 handling.
headline.single_next_move: Implement graph_color C1 A/C counterpart or explicitly final-not-run it, then port/run no-train HB-2 baselines through BudgetRunner.

gate_outcomes.number: A dominates C at 5/5 grid budgets; 4/5 promotion points.
Existing C1 graph_color runner has A-cache/C1 search rows but no C_incontext matched mechanism counterpart yet.
BudgetRunner protocol and repo provenance registry written; no external curves claimed.

decision.next_step_routing: Do not claim targeting-independence or HB-2 yet. The symbolic mechanism-isolation primary is now positive on sudoku, futoshiki, and graph_color; next work is C1 A/C graph_color and external baseline ports.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not establish graph_color C1-targeting independence or external HB-2 competitiveness. It closes only the graph_color symbolic-CBJ matched-budget primary slice.
honesty.graph_color_scope: The graph_color run uses selected v16_p04/R16 symbolic/oracle-search targeting because R4 in the A/C harness produced NO_RECOVERY_TARGET for all selected rows; B* is selected from the C_incontext full-trace token threshold curve.
honesty.depth_limit: Budget curves are thresholded from completed graph_color A/C rows; C depth under budget uses context_rows, while A depth under unsolved budgets is a lower-bound proxy because graph_color A rows store exact full total_tokens but not exact per-event token increments.
honesty.external_limit: HB-2 baseline ports are not implemented or run; registry/provenance only. No external curve is fabricated.
